content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

While Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Stripe have their own strengths and weaknesses, they all share one thing in common: they're centralized platforms that can shut down or restrict access to your digital products at any time. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a base-layer infrastructure solution that gives you complete ownership and control over your digital commerce operations. This means you can build, deploy, and scale your own e-commerce platform, free from the risks and restrictions associated with centralized platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Stripe may have restrictions or limitations in certain countries, but they often try to find ways to work around them or charge extra fees for compliance. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed to work in any country, without the need for expensive workarounds or compromises on security and compliance. This means you can sell your digital products to customers anywhere in the world, without worrying about restrictions or fees.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Each of the centralized platforms has its own payment processing fees, which can add up quickly for sellers. For example, Gumroad charges 3.5% + $0.30 per sale, while Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses NOWPayments, which offers a flat 0.5% fee for all transactions, regardless of the cryptocurrency used. This means you can save money on payment processing fees and pass the savings on to your customers.
The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a permanent, infrastructure-based solution that gives you complete ownership and control over your digital commerce operations.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When you use a centralized platform, you're often locked into their ecosystem and forced to use their tools and services. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) gives you complete ownership and control over your digital commerce operations, from payment processing to product delivery. You can automate your sales and delivery processes using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, and even configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for added security and reliability.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
